title: The Sparrow and the Eagle
logline: A little sparrow watches an eagle carry off a lamb, tries the same trick on a fat ram, gets his feet tangled in the wool and ends up wingless in the shepherd's hut.
moral: Know your own strength: copying someone far stronger than you ends badly.
tone: Light comic fable played straight: the sparrow is earnest, never a fool on purpose; the comedy is scale (a perfect eagle dive at one quarter size). The last minute turns quiet and a little sad, with no cruelty shown on screen.

beats.summary: A little sparrow lives around a sheepfold and watches the flock from the fence.
A great eagle dives on a lamb.
The eagle lifts the lamb and carries it out of sight.
The admiring sparrow decides he can do the same: he has wings too.
He picks the biggest animal in the fold, a fat ram with tangled wool.
He never weighs his strength against the eagle's.
He dives exactly like the eagle, lands on the ram and beats his wings.
The ram does not move an inch.
When he tries to leave, his feet are caught in the matted wool.
Every pull leaves him more frightened and more tired.
The shepherd, who saw it all, picks him off the ram with one hand.
Angry, he plucks the wing feathers and ties the feet with string.
At home the children ask about the strange bird that cannot fly.
He tried to do what a far stronger eagle had done.
The sparrow stays before the children, unable to fly.

sets.description: World 1600 x 1230, ground y 900. Sky by skyCycle (u 0.04-0.12 morning; 0.2 for S5-S9), Library hillTrees behind. A rail fence runs the full width behind the flock: posts every 130 units, 110 tall (tops y 790), two rails with tops at y 815 and y 860, brown with black brush outline. Corner post at x 240, thicker (34 wide) and taller (top y 740) with a flat cap: the sparrow's perch. Gate at x 1380-1500 (two posts, a diagonal-braced leaf that swings open 0..1). Far right behind the fence a small flat-roofed hut silhouette (180 wide, at x 1450, base on the horizon) and one Library tree. Grass band y 880-900 with tufts and a few daisies; pasture ground below in the Library ground colour tinted green. Flock marks: ewes at x 520, 760, 900, 1020 (feet y 920-960), lamb x 640 y 950, ram x 1150 y 920.

scenes.summary: The punishment, told briefly and without cruelty on screen: an angry face, one quick motion hidden by the hand, a few feathers drifting down, short wings, and a string around the feet.

camera.notes: Tight two-shot of the shepherd's head and shoulders with the bird in his hand at chest height (x 1260, y 610, zoom 2.6). Hold. The feathers fall through the bottom of the frame.

scenes.composition: Shepherd's face upper right, the fist with the sparrow lower left of it; both pairs of eyes in the upper half of the panel; sky and one fence post behind.

actions.action: anger arrives: brows drop into a V, mouth sets, he glances at the sky where his lamb went and back at the bird
actions.acting: brow 1, frown; gaze plan sky then bird (the anger has a reason)

actions.action: shrinks into the fist, head pulled down between the shoulders
actions.acting: sq 0.85, lid 0.2, gaze up at him

actions.action: spreads one of the bird's wings between finger and thumb; his other hand passes across it once, quickly
actions.acting: the moving hand covers the wing during the motion; the sparrow's eyes squeeze shut

actions.action: five small brown feathers rock down from the hands and out of the bottom of the frame
actions.acting: seeded sway, each on its own timing

actions.action: opens his eyes and looks at his wings: short rounded stubs now
actions.acting: lifts one, then the other; brows up, beak open
actions.library: bird clipped:1 (wing drawn at 45% length, no primaries)

actions.action: winds a red string twice around the two feet
actions.acting: two quick circular hand passes; face still stern but the brow eases to 0.6

actions.action: the loops sit around both ankles with a small bow; 200 units of string run to his fist
actions.acting: the sparrow tests it with one foot: it holds

actions.acting: a short nod: done
actions.library: person turn (dir flip with squeeze), walk start

scenes.summary: At home. The shepherd comes in and puts the bird down in front of his two children, who lean in, point and ask about the strange bird that cannot fly; the sparrow proves it with one failed hop.

camera.notes: The card clears at about 133.2 on the hut interior (x 500, y 660, zoom 1.15); push in to the children and the bird on the mat (x 430, y 780, zoom 1.9) from "أطفاله".

scenes.composition: Door on the right (x 820); children sitting on the mat at x 330 (girl) and x 520 (boy) facing each other; the sparrow is put down between them at x 425, floor y 900; the shepherd stands at x 660. Window on the back wall at upper left (x 180-320, y 430-560) showing evening sky, used again in S11.

actions.action: transition card LATER... covers the cut from the fold to the hut; behind it the sky moves to late afternoon
actions.acting: card about 1.1 s
actions.library: S.transition(..., {caption:'LATER...'}); skyCycle u 0.38 in the window

actions.action: card clears: the two children sit on the floor mat playing with pebbles
actions.acting: girl stacking, boy watching; neither has seen the door yet
actions.library: person {costume:'maiden', child:true, sit:1, seat:'floor'} and {costume:'servant', child:true, sit:1, seat:'floor'}

actions.acting: walk in three steps; children's heads turn to him one after the other
actions.library: walk(), footfalls(); stagger(i) for the children

actions.action: bends and drops the bird onto the mat between them from hand height (about 60 units)
actions.acting: open hand, short fall, the string trailing after

actions.action: lands on his tied feet, tips over onto his side, scrambles upright
actions.acting: impact squash 0.8, rebound, stub wings out for balance, dizzy blink

actions.action: both children rock back, then lean in close

actions.action: looks from one huge child face to the other, backing up until the string stops him
actions.acting: saccade gaze boy, girl, boy; small tremble

actions.action: the girl tilts her head the other way and holds her palms up: what kind of bird is this?
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp, talk 0.6, gaze up at her father

actions.action: tries to fly: crouch, spring, furious flapping of the short wings
actions.acting: rises 26 units, hangs for 4 frames, drops; the string never even goes taut
actions.library: anticipate(), hop() low arc, bird clipped flap

actions.action: plops back onto the mat and sits
actions.acting: landSquash 0.8; both children's heads follow him up and down

actions.action: pulls the stool over and sits down (in the pause)
actions.acting: heavy sit with a settle; staff across his knees

scenes.summary: The telling and the moral. The shepherd explains with a thought cloud that puts the eagle and the sparrow side by side; then the film stays on the flightless sparrow, who watches a far eagle cross the window and lowers his head. THE END.

camera.notes: Medium three-shot (x 480, y 700, zoom 1.5) with the cloud above the group; from "وبقي" a slow 8 s push-in on the sparrow (x 425, y 800, zoom 2.6) that keeps the window in the top-left corner until 159; final hold.

scenes.composition: Shepherd seated right (x 660), children left and centre on the mat, sparrow between them at x 425; the cloud (centre x 470, y 430, 380 x 260) sits above the children, tail to the shepherd's head; window upper left.

actions.action: leans toward the children and begins to tell it, one finger raised
actions.acting: talk 0.7, calmer face now (brow 0.2), eye contact child to child

actions.action: both children turn from the bird to their father and listen
actions.acting: girl sits back on her heels, boy props his chin on his hand

actions.action: thought cloud opens above them: the little sparrow flapping on the ram's back, the ram chewing
actions.acting: the children look up into the cloud; the real sparrow looks up too and winces

actions.action: inside the cloud a HEIGHT 0 tag pops by the ram's hooves
actions.acting: the boy giggles (shoulders bob twice)
actions.library: S.counter inside the cloud; person sq pulse

actions.action: the cloud picture is pushed aside by the eagle swooping in with the lamb, filling two thirds of the cloud
actions.acting: children's eyes widen; the girl grabs her brother's sleeve
actions.library: thoughtCloud inside: eagle s large, lamb

actions.action: in the cloud the eagle and the sparrow hover side by side at true scale; label with arrow on the eagle: STRONG
actions.acting: the sparrow in the cloud looks up at the eagle and gulps

actions.action: shows it with his hands: arms spread wide for the eagle, then finger and thumb a pinch apart for the sparrow
actions.acting: armsOut then a pinch at eye level, eyebrows up on the pinch

actions.action: the cloud pops away (in the pause); everyone's eyes come down to the real bird
actions.acting: staggered: shepherd, girl, boy

actions.action: begins the slow push-in on the sparrow on the mat
actions.acting: 8 s ease

actions.action: sits very still between the two children, looking at the floor
actions.acting: lid 0.35, slow breathe(), string slack beside him

actions.action: the girl lowers herself to his eye level, chin on her hands
actions.acting: soft face, mouth closed, slow blink

actions.action: lifts one short wing and looks at it
actions.acting: gaze on the wing, brows up (sad)

actions.action: lets the wing fall; lifts the other, lets it fall
actions.acting: each drop a little heavier; head sinks 6 units

actions.action: looks up at the window and the evening sky
actions.acting: gaze up-left to the window, lid 0

actions.action: far away in the window a small eagle silhouette glides across the orange sky, wings locked
actions.acting: crosses in 2.2 s; the sparrow's pupils follow it from frame edge to frame edge
actions.library: bird {kind:'hawk'} s 0.35 as a silhouette clipped to the window; lookAt()

actions.action: the silhouette is gone; his eyes stay on the empty window a moment, then break away and his head drops
actions.acting: shame ending pattern: hold, break the look, head down

actions.action: a tiny thought cloud the size of his head: the ram, still chewing; it pops
actions.acting: he shakes his head once at it
actions.library: thoughtCloud small (120 x 90), inside: sheep ram head

actions.action: the girl slides a few grains of wheat across the mat to him with one finger
actions.acting: gentle, eyes on him; the boy watches her do it

actions.action: looks at the grain, then closes his eyes: one tear, one long blink
actions.acting: wet:true, lid 0 to 1 over 0.6 s, small sigh (sq 1.03 to 0.95)

actions.action: THE END, held over the still group until 166.5
actions.acting: title in the sky-coloured upper wall area, clear of all faces; the sparrow breathes, the girl blinks

ending.description: After the last word (163.32) the push-in has stopped on the sparrow sitting between the children, eyes closed, the grains in front of him, the empty window behind. THE END pops at 163.6 and holds to 166.5 with only breathing and one blink from the girl; a quiet chime at 163.8.

subtitles.ar: كان عصفور صغير يطير فوق حظيرة مليئة بالأغنام،|ويتوقف أحيانًا على السور ليراقبها.|وفي صباح رأى نسرًا كبيرًا يحلق في السماء،|ثم ينقض بسرعة على حمل صغير.
subtitles.en: A little sparrow flew over a sheepfold|and sometimes watched the sheep from its fence.|One morning it saw a great eagle|swoop toward a young lamb.

subtitles.ar: أمسك النسر بالحمل بين مخالبه القوية،|وارتفع به فوق الحظيرة حتى اختفى بعيدًا.|نظر العصفور إليه بإعجاب وقال لنفسه:|«لماذا لا أفعل مثله؟ عندي جناحان كما عنده».
subtitles.en: The eagle seized the lamb in powerful talons|and carried it high away.|The admiring sparrow thought,|“Why not do the same? I too have wings.”

subtitles.ar: بحث العصفور عن حيوان كبير يستطيع أن يحمله.|رأى كبشًا سمينًا يقف بين الأغنام،|وعلى ظهره صوف كثيف متشابك.|لم يفكر العصفور في الفرق بين قوته وقوة النسر.
subtitles.en: The sparrow sought a large animal to carry.|It saw a fat ram|with thick, tangled wool|and did not consider the difference between its own strength and the eagle’s.

subtitles.ar: طار إلى أعلى قليلًا،|ثم اندفع نحو ظهر الكبش مثل النسر.|غرز قدميه في الصوف، وضرب جناحيه بقوة،|منتظرًا أن يرتفع الكبش عن الأرض. لكنه لم يتحرك من مكانه.
subtitles.en: It rose|and swooped onto the ram’s back like the eagle,|digging its feet into the fleece and beating its wings.|The ram did not lift an inch.

subtitles.ar: حاول العصفور الطيران وحده،|لكنه اكتشف أن قدميه علقتا في الصوف المتسخ المتشابك.|شد جناحيه مرة بعد مرة،|وكلما حاول الإفلات ازداد اضطرابه وتعبه.
subtitles.en: The sparrow tried to fly away alone,|but its feet were caught in the filthy matted wool.|It pulled and beat its wings,|growing more frightened and exhausted.

subtitles.ar: كان الراعي قد شاهد النسر وهو يحمل الحمل،|ثم رأى العصفور يقلده.|اقترب من الكبش ووجد الطائر الصغير عاجزًا عن الحركة.|أمسكه بسهولة، رغم كل محاولاته للهرب.
subtitles.en: The shepherd had seen both the eagle’s success|and the sparrow’s imitation.|He approached the ram|and easily seized the trapped little bird.

subtitles.ar: غضب الراعي من العصفور، فنتف ريش جناحيه وربط قدميه بخيط.|ثم أخذه إلى بيته وألقاه أمام أطفاله،|الذين سألوه عن هذا الطائر الغريب الذي لا يستطيع الطيران.
subtitles.en: Angry, the shepherd pulled out the sparrow’s wing feathers, tied its feet with string,|and took it home.|His children asked about the strange bird that could not fly.

subtitles.ar: أخبرهم الراعي أنه حاول أن يفعل ما فعله نسر أقوى منه بكثير.|وبقي العصفور أمام الأطفال بلا ريش كاف للطيران،|بعدما انتهت محاولته لحمل الكبش بهذه الطريقة المؤلمة.
subtitles.en: The shepherd told them it had tried to do what a far stronger eagle had done.|The sparrow remained before the children, unable to fly,|after its painful attempt.

new_assets.name: sheep
new_assets.description: One woolly sheep figure for ewe, ram and lamb, reusable in every farm or shepherd story. Feet at (x, y), side view facing dir. At s 1: wool body a cloud 230 wide x 150 tall (fat 0) to 270 x 165 (fat 1) with its base 55 above the feet; four black legs 14 wide; black face 70 x 80 on a short neck, ears 40 x 16; small tail puff. Fields: ph, amp (walk), fat 0..1, chew, talk (bleat), headDown 0..1 (graze), headTurn -1..1 (look back), earL/earR, ram:true (two curled horns, each a 2-turn spiral of radius 34, yellow with brown rings), lamb:true (s x0.6, head 1.25x, legs 1.2x, no horns), tangle 0..1 (matted patch on the back: 60 x 26 area of grey-brown knot loops, two burrs, a twig), pal (white, cream, grey face), seed, eyes 'wide', plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Wool: 9-11 overlapping circles along an ellipse from K.rng(seed), filled paper white with blue Ben-Day dot shading on the underside and a fat black brush outline (same recipe as the Library bush and cloud). Legs with walk() phases like the deer. Face: rounded box, the shared eye2 eyes, a sideways-sliding jaw for chew. Horns: two stroked spirals. Tangle: short random arcs and loops in a clipped patch with a brown multiply tint. Wrap with acting() in registry.js.

new_assets.name: hawk (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The planned bird of prey kind on the Library bird (hooked beak, heavy brow, talons), here with an eagle palette: dark brown body and wings, white head and tail, yellow beak and feet. Extra fields used by this film: soar 0..1 (wings locked flat with 5 spread finger feathers), fold 0..1 (wings swept back for the dive), talons 0..1 (legs swung forward, toes spread), grip 0..1 (toes closed on something), wingsUp.
new_assets.implementation: Add the palette to the BIRD table and draw the wing as a long tapered polygon with finger notches when soar > 0; legs as two short thick strokes ending in three hooked toes that rotate with talons/grip. Scale 2.6 for the hero shots, 0.35 as a silhouette in the window.

new_assets.name: sheepfold
new_assets.description: Fenced pasture, 1600 wide, with a corner perch post, a gate and a far hut (dimensions under sets).
new_assets.implementation: bake() once: skyCycle or sky preset, hillTrees, far hut and tree, grass band with tufts; the fence as a separate function fence(ctx, {x0, x1, step, h, gate}) so other farm sets can use it; the gate leaf drawn live (rotation faked by scaling its width).

new_assets.name: hutRoom
new_assets.description: The planned hut cutaway with a door on the right, a window upper left with a live sky, a floor mat, a jug and a shelf.
new_assets.implementation: Flat wall and floor rectangles with dot shading, baked; window and door are holes filled by skyCycle(u) drawn first, so the far eagle silhouette can be clipped to the window rectangle.

new_assets.name: bird clipped wings
new_assets.description: Bird field clipped 0..1: the wing is drawn at 45% length with a rounded end and no primary feathers; flap and sag still work.
new_assets.implementation: Scale the wing polygon length by 1 - 0.55 * clipped about the shoulder and replace the tip with an arc. Off by default (regression safe).

new_assets.name: bird carry
new_assets.description: The planned carry option: an object (here the lamb, and the dream sheep) hangs from the talons and swings a beat late.
new_assets.implementation: Scene-level rig: the load is drawn before the bird at the talon point plus swing(t) offset; grip closes the toes over it.

new_assets.name: featherFall
new_assets.description: The planned effect: n feathers released at a point at t0 that rock down on seeded sway paths.
new_assets.implementation: For each feather: x = x0 + A sin(w (t - t0) + phase), y by a slow fall, rotation following the sway; a 22 x 8 leaf shape with a centre line.

new_assets.name: woolSnare
new_assets.description: Elastic wool strands between the fleece and the bird's feet: slack, taut (straight, humming 1 unit), stretch up to 40 units, snap and recoil; also the fleece tenting up under a pull.
new_assets.implementation: Four quadratic curves from fixed fleece points to the ankle points; control point sag from 1 - tension; snap = retract over 3 frames with a small curl. Drawn after the bird so the strands cross the toes.

new_assets.name: string
new_assets.description: Red string with ankle loops, a bow and a slack line (see props).
new_assets.implementation: Two ellipses around the ankles, a bow of two loops, and a catenary-like quadratic curve to the other end; same idea as the planned rope (lead), thinner.

owner_questions: The feather plucking is softened: the shepherd's hand hides the wing during one quick motion and we see only five feathers drifting down and the short wings afterwards (default: softened, no pulling shown).
"Threw him before his children" is staged as a short drop from hand height onto the floor mat, not a hard throw (default: short drop).
Added a gentle closing touch not in the script: the daughter slides a few grains of wheat to the sparrow in the last seconds (default: keep; remove if the ending should stay purely stern).
Added a far eagle silhouette crossing the hut window at 157.5 s as a silent echo of the opening (default: keep).
The lamb is shown unharmed and bleating while it is carried off; nothing is shown of what happens to it afterwards (default: as described).

Invented English lettering beyond labels: GRAB!, BAA!, WOW!, TWO WINGS!, pff, FLAP! FLAP! FLAP!, HEIGHT 0, NOT AN INCH, BOING!, STUCK!, PULL 1/2/3, POP!, PECK!, STRONG, ONE MORNING..., LATER... (default: keep all; about 16 items, trim on review if crowded).
The sparrow is the Library brown bird (kind lark) with the crest kept low rather than a newly drawn sparrow (default: reuse; a sparrow palette with a black bib is optional).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world width 1600 for the sheepfold (camera clamps to WW), 1000 for the hut.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every sheep and person blinks on its own seed; give explicit lid values only where the plan asks.
The eagle dive (S2) and the sparrow dive (S6) should share one path function at two scales and the same camera framing: the copy is the joke.
All sparrow flight on bezier paths with flap phase from distance travelled (Lark flyBz pattern); the eagle soars with zero flap except the three lift strokes at 24.6, 25.3 and after.
Sheep never move in unison: give each a seed for chew phase and blink, and use stagger(i) of 0.1-0.2 s for every group reaction.
Use panel-only shake (template) only for the grab at 20.24 (2 units, 4 frames). No shake when the sparrow lands at 67.92: the absence is the gag.
Counters: HEIGHT 0 (75.6-81) and PULL 1-3 (93.92, 95.72, 96.88) with the style counter primitive; keep them out of the caption panel.
The LATER... card at 132.0 covers the set change; put the camera cut at its covered midpoint. The narrator speaks under the card, which is fine.
Sound effects only at the listed pause times (5.95, 19.5, 20.2, 24.8, 37.3, 40.5, 46.7, 123.2, 143.9, 151.75, 163.8), master 0.6; no effect for the comic landing or the pulls, they sit under speech.
Subtitle chunks are in "subtitles"; copy them to chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt unchanged.
Keep every face and the sparrow above panel y 1250; in the hut the mat action sits at world y 780-900, so frame with the camera y at about 760-800.
warnings: Three new drawn animals in effect (sheep with ram and lamb variants, and the planned hawk kind) plus two sets: this is a heavier build than a Library-only story. The sheep is one function with flags, which keeps it to one drawing.
The sparrow at s 0.7 is small next to the ram; every beat that depends on his face uses zoom 1.9 or more. Check phone legibility of the feet insert (89.5) and the fist shots (118-131).

The person figure is front-facing only: the shepherd bending over the ram and holding a bird relies on lean and world hand targets (handRW); arms are short (about 74 units), so place him close to the ram.
P7 packs anger, plucking, tying, the walk home and the children into 19 s; the plucking has only about 2 s (126.6-128.6). Keep it to the single hidden motion.
Words marked ~ in the timeline (في 91.38, عن 116.92, ريش 128.66) have interpolated times; no cue in this plan depends on them.
The planned hawk kind and hutRoom are not in the Library yet; if another film builds them first, reuse that drawing and add only the eagle palette and the window.
